_comment: Where the mascot sits, per OBS scene. Camera space: x and y are pixels in
the 1920x1080 OBS canvas, not page coordinates -- the mascot is a sibling
of the comic page, never a passenger on it, so a pan never drags it along.
x,y is the PIVOT: the point the gaze rotates about, which sits `pivot` of
the way down the cell (0.30 = roughly the head). It is not the cell's
top-left and it is not its centre.
A scene with no entry here hides the mascot. Author these by dragging:
in OBS via right-click -> Interact, then paste the JSON it prints.
